textSizeNormal: Text size: normal. Press to make it larger.
textSizeLarge: Text size: large. Press to make it larger.
textSizeXL: Text size: largest. Press to return to normal.
joinSub: Ask your lecturer for the session code. No name is needed.
joinError: That code was not found. Check it with your lecturer.
joinNote: Anonymous by design: no name, roll number or seat is collected.
anonBanner: Pins are anonymous. The lecturer sees counts only, never who pinned.
slidesSub: Find the slide where you lost the thread and tap Pin.
errMsg: Check your connection, then tap Retry. Your pin is kept until it is sent.
undoErr: Could not remove the pin. Check your connection, then try Undo again.
commentSub: About slide {n}. No name is attached.
commentPlaceholder: e.g. What is the base case for?
commentErr: Comment not sent. Check your connection, then try again.
commentEmpty: Write a comment first, or choose Skip.
myPinsSub: Slides you have pinned in this lecture. Only you can see this list.
myPinsEmpty: You have not pinned a slide yet.
offlineText: Waiting for the lecturer to start, or you are offline. Check you are on the lecture Wi-Fi.
helpAnon1: A pin is stored only as a number on a slide. No name, roll number, seat, phone or device id is saved with it.
helpAnon2: Comments are stored with the slide number and the text you type. Do not write anything that could identify you.
helpAnon3: When a slide has fewer than 3 pins, the lecturer sees "a few", so one student cannot be guessed.
helpKey1: Press Tab to move between controls and Enter or Space to press one.
helpKey2: Pin, undo, comment and error messages are announced by a screen reader.
helpKey3: Use the text size button in the top bar to make everything larger.
fewNote: Counts under 3 show as "a few", so one student cannot be guessed.
emptyText: When students pin a slide, counts will appear here. Nothing needs to be done now.
joinNet: Could not reach the server. Check you are on the lecture Wi-Fi, then try again.
afterSub: Your pinned slides come first. This is from your own lecture.
waiting: Waiting for the lecturer to start
waitingSub: This page updates by itself when the lecture begins.
afterEmpty: No summaries were saved for this lecture.
noTranscript: No transcript was saved for this lecture.
lecAuthSub: Students never sign in. Only you do, so you can keep your sessions and reports.
lecHave: Already have an account? Sign in
noSessions: No sessions yet. Create one to get a code for your students.
dropSub: PDF, up to 50 MB. Each page becomes a slide students scroll through.
slidesFound: {n} slides found. Titles were read from each slide. Check them before you start.
tellStudents: Tell students to open Attentive and enter
noNameNeeded: No name needed. They can join late and still see every slide so far.
addLineHint: Type what you just said. Students get it after class.
forNextText: Slide {n} had the most pins. Consider opening the next class with one worked example of it.
forNextNone: No slide reached 3 pins, so nothing stands out. Students did not report a clear trouble spot.
fewNoteLec: Counts under 3 show as "a few", so one student cannot be guessed.
err_email_taken: That email already has an account. Sign in instead.
err_bad_credentials: Email or password is not right.
err_invalid_input: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
err_not_a_pdf: That file is not a PDF.
err_unreadable_pdf: We could not read that PDF. Try another file.
err_session_started: The lecture has started, so slides can no longer change.
err_server_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
err_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
deleteConfirm: Delete this session and everything in it?
